intro.text: N1234 is a Cessna on an active Lake Reporting flight plan and actively monitoring your frequency of 122.3. N1324, another Cessna, calls on 122.3 to inquire about weather information along their route of flight. Pilot: “Good morning Green Bay Radio. November One Three Two Four calling on One Two Two Point Three needing updated weather information on some cloud development to the west of my route.” Think about how should the Specialist respond to N1324?
